summary: Blue Owl Digital Infrastructure Trust filed an 8-K reporting unregistered sales of 12,470,870 common shares for ~$131.7 million at NAV per share ($10.41–10.59) under Regulation D/S and declared distributions of ~$0.0417 per share. This is a routine capital raise and dividend declaration, not a special-situation event. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change. The filing is a standard periodic disclosure of equity sales and distributions.
